config.split_note: Two-stage GroupShuffleSplit on WT_cluster with seed 42 (src/split_data.py), aiming at 70/15/15

struct_desc.st_found: 1 if the protein has a matched AlphaFold model
struct_desc.st_contacts_8: residues with a side-chain anchor (C-beta, C-alpha for glycine) within 8 Å
struct_desc.st_hse_up: C-alpha atoms within 13 Å on the side the side chain points to (half-sphere exposure)
struct_desc.st_local_span: distance from residue i−2 to i+2: about 6 Å in a helix, 12 Å or more in a strand
struct_desc.st_burial_rank: rank of st_contacts_10 within the protein, 0 = most exposed, 1 = most buried
struct_desc.st_rsa: relative solvent-accessible surface area (0 = fully buried, 1 = fully exposed), Shrake-Rupley
struct_desc.st_neigh_hyd: mean hydrophobicity of the residues within 10 Å in 3D (not in sequence)
struct_desc.st_centroid_dist: distance from the protein's centre, divided by its radius of gyration
struct_desc.x_hyd_burial: hydrophobicity change × burial (1 − relative surface area)
